name: Deva

traits.name: Exalted Restoration
traits.desc: If the deva dies outside Mount Celestia, its body disappears and it gains a new body 1d6 days later.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The deva makes two Holy Mace attacks.

actions.name: Divine Aid
actions.desc: The deva casts Cure Wounds, Lesser Restoration or Remove Curse without components.

bonusActions.name: Change Shape
bonusActions.desc: The deva becomes a humanoid or beast of CR 10 or lower, or returns to its true form.

desc: An angelic messenger sent to mortals: calm, radiant and absolutely certain of its purpose.
